p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, start a business, investment platforms: the official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, opens up the updated official sources, so you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for a product and a country, duties, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (MAM): Customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health rules that this country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs code and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): Starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): checks that a platform has not been reported by a regulator before entrusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: A site opens in your language: use the translation of your browser, or « Understanding a document » for a document in your language.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between countries.24/24 ONE WORLD does not submit customs declarations: an authorized customs agent (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market access map (ITC, UN-WTO): tariffs and rules for almost all countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): duties, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_t4: French Customs: EORI, customs clearance, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d3: Shipping document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Waybill (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to obtain reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (companies importing or exporting to the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods cleared for export to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Seller loads on ship; after that, risk and costs are borne by buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: the seller pays the freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays customs duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including customs duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines, such lists are rejected and can be reported.
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly… compare the rates for your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money by itself and does not earn anything from these links: you compare here, then send with the service you choose.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Remittance prices worldwide (World Bank): the real cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, fees are shown before sending
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total you receive: fees + exchange rate, a rate worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN…).
p.espaces.mt_k3: Often an identity document is required, both for sending and for collecting.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only met online, or to "unlock" a prize, package, loan or visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check on their website when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: Selling without stocks: find a supplier, calculate the real price, comply with the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier ships directly to your customer: easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product authorized in your customers’ country: no counterfeit, no regulated product without authorization.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesale / supplier" here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: business status, VAT and taxes based on your country (see Business Rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting customer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of withdrawal, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment via unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: banned and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a parcel from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
